description: This file defines a React-like component for creating a new note in a notes application. It includes form fields for title, content, and tags, and manages the note creation process with loading and error states. The component integrates with navigation and external createNote API.

methods.name: onCreate$
methods.description: Handles the creation of a new note by calling the createNote API, managing loading and error states, and navigating to the notes list upon success.
